name: thesis-bus-algorithm-matrix-v6
interpretation: Adapt the existing RE-SAC learner to the frozen CS multi-line simulator without changing its update equations. Common raw observation information, same-vehicle replay, normalized execution, reward ledger, 100 training days and test days. RE-SAC embeds five genuine categorical fields and keeps ten normalized continuous fields. Batch size, critic count, hidden width and learning rate match the frozen CS recipe; other RE-SAC settings are retained. ensemble_sac_control disables both RE-SAC uncertainty regularizers; it is a matched ensemble-SAC control, not a claim of a separate vanilla SAC implementation. CS reference endpoints are reused, with holding symbolic endpoints evaluated on the same days. This is a new matched-environment cohort, not pooled with native RE-SAC.
